extracted.intended_audience: writers submitting fiction to Strange Horizons (speculative fiction authors), including novelette authors and Indigenous authors
extracted.subtask_description: Announces Strange Horizons' 2025 open fiction submission windows, caps, and basic requirements (including a specified novelette length range) and directs authors to the full fiction submission guidelines. Useful for authors planning when and how to submit short fiction, novelettes, or Indigenous-author submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: General Submissions window and cap
rubrics_metrics.description: General Submissions: April 16th at 9 a.m. UTC with a 1,000 story cap
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once we reach the caps on these open submissions, we’ll close our portal while we work through the submissions. If our portal is open, we are still accepting stories, but once it is closed, please do not send us your work. Since we are using a story caps, we encourage authors to submit promptly!

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelette Submissions window, cap, and length requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Novelette Submissions: June 4th at 9 a.m. UTC with a 300 story cap*
rubrics_metrics.guidance: *For our novelette submissions, we will be open to stories between 10,000 and 18,000 words. More information on these submissions will be posted at a later date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indigenous Author Submissions window and cap
rubrics_metrics.description: Indigenous Author Submissions: November 3rd at 9 a.m. UTC with a 500 story cap
rubrics_metrics.guidance: More information on the indigenous author submissions will be posted at a later date. This is a separate open submission window reserved for Indigenous authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Story cap and portal-closure policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Once story caps are reached the submission portal will be closed while the staff works through submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the portal is open, Strange Horizons is accepting stories; once closed, authors should not send work. The caps are enforced to manage volume and turnaround; authors are encouraged to submit promptly when windows open.

rubrics_metrics.name: Response timeline for prior submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: All submissions submitted during our last open submission period will be responded and decided on before the open submission in April.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strange Horizons aims to clear decisions on the previous open-submission backlog before opening the next general window, giving authors an expectation of when they will hear back relative to the open windows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refer to fiction submission guidelines for detailed requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Please see our fiction submission guidelines for more details on how to submit once we open and what we publish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This announcement provides dates and caps only; authors must consult the full fiction submission guidelines for formatting, simultaneous submission policy, content/style preferences, rights requested, submission format, and other editorial requirements.
